hypothesis: A TRAIN-learned dictionary of universally certified relational motifs can replace repeated per-instance role-binding search with compositional proof-carrying relation summaries, reducing total measured native inference work and memory on independently source-born unfamiliar compositions without losing exactness compared with fully trained and exact competitors.

original_mechanism.name: Proof-carrying relational motif basis (PCRMB)
original_mechanism.key_distinction: Learn reusable representation units, not contingent query priority, branch elimination order, or T20 quotient search scheduling.
original_mechanism.representation: For S3, a motif denotes a 3x216 bitset-valued relation indexed by all three shared-role permutation identities (6^3). Each output-state relation is derived from exact composition, including inverses and repeated role bindings. A stored motif is admissible only with a deterministic universal-equivalence certificate against the full 216-binding algebra, with exact source/grammar/toolchain identity.
original_mechanism.learning: On independently admitted TRAIN tasks only, construct a strictly capacity-limited, public-only motif dictionary using deterministic description-length / observed motif compression savings; all dictionary entries must be verifier-certified, and no DEV labels, hidden operators, or prospective tasks can influence dictionary construction. Learned parameters are selected relational motifs, not rank weights.
original_mechanism.composition: For an unseen word, select verified reusable motifs from the frozen dictionary and combine their exact relations while respecting globally persistent role identities; otherwise revert to exact symbolic control. Cost to instantiate, combine, prove and query is counted.
original_mechanism.proof_boundary: A digest binds the certified table but is not sufficient on its own; acceptance requires independently replayable full algebraic equivalence and source identity. Any absent certificate, wrong role identity, inconsistent pair, cap overflow, unknown template or mismatched digest fails closed.

qualification.algorithmic_founding_gate: T21_B exact bitset relation and independent exhaustive verifier over all 216 S3 role assignments; test role alpha-renaming, reversal, inverse, noncommuting order and repeated-use semantics, without DEV source
qualification.learning_gate: T21_C implement bounded TRAIN-only motif selection and equally informed comparators using authenticated independent TRAIN once admitted
qualification.first_use_gate: T21_D independently witnessed unfamiliar family global-first-use one-time prospective comparison, only after source admission
qualification.tests: Linux and Windows GitHub-hosted CPU/memory-instrumented runs, adversarial equivalence checks, deterministic test identities; no local runner and no research interference
qualification.combined_success: zero hard false positives, zero baseline correct losses, strict learned representation advantage vs fully trained and trained-motif controls, no regression of complete CPU or peak memory or native public query work, same service cost, verified novel family transfer and independent replication
qualification.performance: include source-origin costs when inside experiment, training, motif compilation, verifier, inference, fallback, queries, peak RSS, wall and CPU; report amortization horizon without omitting setup
qualification.preserved_final_system_regression: one final full regression before any later integration if permitted
